AMEC.why: Chinese etch / deposition tool maker: its plasma etch tools run in volume production of 128-layer-and-above 3D NAND and its tungsten deposition tools serve 3D memory word lines, so NAND capex drives its orders
AMEC.evidence: AMEC 2026 Half-Year Report (08-20-2026): 'In 3D NAND manufacturing, the company's plasma etch tools are used in volume production of 128 layers and above'

players.product: plasma etch tools for 3D NAND and advanced logic (CCP incl. 60:1 ultra-high-aspect-ratio dielectric etch; cryogenic high-aspect-ratio ICP etch) plus tungsten CVD / ALD deposition for 3D NAND word lines

quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SSE e-Interactive: as customer orders enter a period of large-scale delivery it keeps working closely with its supply chain to raise delivery capacity; it has a good overseas customer base and has cumulatively delivered about 800 reaction chambers to the most advanced overseas logic customer(s); it keeps engaging more prospective overseas customers.
quarterly_data.figure: about 800 reaction chambers delivered cumulatively to overseas most-advanced logic customer(s)
